entities.summary: Lawrence, a notable figure in the history of Jordan, associated with Late Ottoman Transjordan (1916–1918). Preceded by Hashemite-led Arab Revolt and Ottoman Empire. Their legacy influenced T.E. Lawrence and Arab forces capture Aqaba in a daring desert assault and Winston Churchill establishes the Emirate of Transjordan under Abdullah I.
